writeup:
### The arc
The most one-sided matchup of the week. Scarlet Knights never got above ~14% (opening night) and were effectively done by June 3. Not a single tick swung 7pp — there was no drama to swing. The Norsemen took nine categories; Scarlet's lone win was SVHD.

### What swung it
- Nothing — Scarlet's staff (7.20 ERA / 1.68 WHIP) handed the Norsemen every pitching category, and the offense followed.

**Turning point:** There wasn't one; this was a mismatch from first pitch.
